description: This file provides utility functions to read files if they exist and to collect plugin source information from a specified directory structure, specifically targeting plugin extensions with certain manifest files.

methods.name: readIfExists
methods.description: Reads the content of a file at the specified path, returning null if the file does not exist or an error occurs.

methods.name: collectBundledPluginSources
methods.description: Collects information about plugin sources within the 'extensions' directory of a repository, optionally requiring a package.json to be present, and returns a sorted list of plugin entries.
